# UI design review checklist

Use this generated checklist with the source trace and confidence level; it is not a compliance certificate.

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0001 — Choose or apply an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0002 — Choose or apply action sheets sparingly in the documented context. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0003 — Apply the documented Action sheets guidance to aim to keep titles short enough to display on a single line. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0004 — Make a message only if necessary available when applicable. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0005 — Apply the documented Action sheets guidance to make destructive choices visually prominent. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0006 — Choose or apply an action sheet — not a menu — to provide choices related to an action in the documented context. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0007 — Exclude letting an action sheet scroll from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0008 — Exclude displaying more than four buttons in an action sheet, including the Cancel button from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/action-sheets))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0001 — Display Activity rings when they're relevant to the app's purpose. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0002 — Use Activity rings only for Move, Exercise, and Stand progress. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0003 — Use Activity rings to show progress for a single person. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0004 — Always preserve the visual appearance of Activity rings wherever they appear. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0005 — Maintain the required outer margin around Activity rings. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0006 — Avoid notifications that repeat Activity app progress information. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0007 — Avoid using Activity rings as decoration. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0008 — Avoid using Activity rings for branding. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0009 — Never alter Activity ring colors, filters, or opacity. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0010 — Always display Activity rings on a black background. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0011 — Prefer enclosing Activity rings and their black background within a circle. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0012 — Ensure the black background remains visible around the outermost Activity ring. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0013 — Always scale Activity rings so they remain visually connected and appropriately placed. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0014 — Never use Activity rings to display data other than Move, Exercise, or Stand progress. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0015 — Never show Move, Exercise, or Stand progress in another ring-like element. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0016 — Never use Activity rings to represent data for more than one person. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0017 — Ensure it's obvious whose progress Activity rings show. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0018 — When necessary, design the surrounding interface to blend with Activity rings. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0019 — Never change Activity rings to blend with the surrounding interface. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0020 — Use the matching Activity ring color for directly associated labels and values. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0021 — Never let other elements crop, obstruct, or encroach on Activity rings or their margin. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0022 — Differentiate other ring-like elements from Activity rings. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0023 — Avoid showing an Activity ring element in app notifications. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0024 — Avoid offering Activity rings on macOS, tvOS, or visionOS. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0025 — Avoid gradients, shadows, or other visual effects around the outer Activity ring. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0026 — Never display Activity rings in labels or background graphics. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0027 — Never use Activity rings in app icons or marketing materials. (MUST_NOT, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-rings))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0001 — Avoid duplicating common actions already available in the activity view. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0002 — Consider using a symbol to represent a custom activity. (MAY, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0003 — Use a succinct, descriptive title for each custom action. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0004 — Ensure every displayed activity is appropriate for the current context. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0005 — Use the Share button to reveal an activity view. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0006 — Avoid displaying an additional modal view above an extension. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0007 — Use the main app to show the status of a lengthy extension task. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0008 — Give an app-specific activity a custom title when it resembles an existing action. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0009 — Center a custom activity icon in an area about 70 by 70 pixels. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0010 — Prefer a single verb or brief verb phrase that clearly describes a custom action. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0011 — Avoid including a company or product name in a custom-action title. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0012 — Consider excluding system activities that aren't applicable to the current app context. (MAY, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0013 — Avoid providing another way to reveal the same activity view. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0014 — When a custom extension interface is necessary, make it feel familiar. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0015 — Prefer the system-provided composition view for a share extension. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0016 — Include the app name in an action extension interface. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0017 — Include recognizable app-interface elements when an extension presents a custom interface. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0018 — Streamline extension interactions and limit the steps needed to complete the task. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0019 — When necessary, provide an image that communicates the extension's purpose. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0020 — For an action extension, prefer a symbol or interface icon that clearly identifies the task. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0021 — Continue a time-consuming extension task in the background. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0022 — Avoid notifying people solely because an extension task completes. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0023 — Avoid offering an activity view on macOS, tvOS, or watchOS. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/activity-views))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0001 — Choose or apply alerts sparingly in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0002 — Exclude using an alert merely to provide information from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0003 — Exclude displaying alerts for common, undoable actions, even when they’re destructive from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0004 — Exclude showing an alert when your app starts from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0005 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to write a title that clearly and succinctly describes the situation. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0006 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to include informative text only if it adds value. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0007 — Exclude explaining alert buttons from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0008 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to create succinct, logical button titles. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0009 — Exclude using OK as the default button title unless the alert is purely informational from the applicable experience. (AVOID, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0010 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to place buttons where people expect. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0011 — Use destructive styling when an alert button performs a destructive action the person didn’t deliberately choose. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0012 — Provide platform-appropriate keyboard, Home Screen, or remote actions for canceling an alert. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0013 — Choose or apply an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0014 — Choose or apply a caution symbol sparingly in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0016 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to include a text field only when needed to resolve the situation. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0017 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to include a Cancel button when an alert offers a destructive action. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0020 — Choose or apply a custom macOS alert view only for necessary additional information in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0029 — Choose or apply title-style capitalization without ending punctuation for title fragments in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0033 — Choose or apply appropriate punctuation in alert informative text in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0034 — Apply the documented Alerts guidance to aim for one- or two-word alert button titles. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0046 — Choose or apply done instead of Cancel for a single default alert button in the documented context. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-ALERTS-0047 — Minimize alert scrolling on iOS and iPadOS by using short titles and only necessary brief messages. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/alerts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0001 — Make app Shortcuts for your app’s most common and important tasks available when applicable. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/app-shortcuts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0002 — Apply the documented App Shortcuts guidance to ask for clarification in response to a request that’s missing optional information. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/app-shortcuts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0004 — Apply the documented App Shortcuts guidance to make App Shortcuts discoverable in your app. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/app-shortcuts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0005 — Make enough detail for interaction on audio-only devices available when applicable. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/app-shortcuts))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0006 — Make brief, memorable activation phrases and natural variants available when applicable. (SHOULD, low; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/app-shortcuts))

- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0001 — Make buttons easy for people to recognize, select, and activate. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0002 — Always provide a visible press state for every custom button. (MUST, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons))
- [ ] HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0003 — Use visual style rather than size to distinguish a preferred button among multiple options. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons))
